description: PgWire catalog smoke passed 13/13, adding scalar metadata, information_schema tables/columns, pg_type, and pg_class probes on top of BENCHPROD-085 protocol coverage.
FusionDB now serves a targeted virtual PostgreSQL metadata surface from the PgWire handler before falling through to the SQL executor.
Rust PgWire integration test suite still passes after metadata handling changes: cargo test --test pg_integration -- --nocapture => 9 passed.
Expand JDBC-style catalog probes to server_version/current_setting, pg_database, pg_attribute, broader pg_namespace/pg_class shapes, and optional PostgreSQL JDBC driver smoke.
